Side pocket for storage space

This sofa combines practical features with modern aesthetics – the side storage pocket holds a remote control, magazines, snacks or mobile phones, so everyday essentials are always within reach, yet discreetly concealed. Modular seat cushions

Each seat cushion of this sofa is an independent module – easy to separate and recombine. This is how you define its shape depending on the situation: as a large family couch for socializing, as a comfortable lying surface for naps, or as individual seats for flexible use of space. Whether it's a movie night with an enclosing seating area, spontaneous overnight guests or a reading corner in everyday life: it meets every requirement with gentle intelligence.

Fully vacuum-compressed sofa

Innovative full vacuum packaging – unfolds automatically and without tools to a complete shape after unpacking. In minutes, it transforms from a compact package into a comfortable sofa: just position it and relax immediately. Difficult installation, lost screws and incomprehensible instructions are a thing of the past. With effortless handling and quick integration into the living room, study or bedroom.

Versatile use

With its highly flexible design, this sofa breaks the boundaries of conventional furniture: as an orderly seating area for social gatherings, can be transformed into a guest bed for overnight stays in a flash, or as a spacious play zone for children. Whether as the centrepiece in the living room, a multifunctional solution in the office for lunch breaks and reception, or as a space miracle in the student apartment – its intelligent adaptability makes it a universal companion for a wide range of life scenarios.

Easy maintenance

The easy-care fabric cover is pleasantly soft, durable and easy to clean - ideal for daily use with children or pets. Whether for a spontaneous family movie night or improvised living room camping - it fits easily into any situation and becomes a reliable companion for shared moments full of laughter and cosiness.

Stylish & functional

More than just a piece of furniture – an intelligent room concept for the modern, mobile lifestyle. Whether it's frequent tenant moves, annual changes of residence by students or seasonal use in small urban apartments: it integrates into your life in the "easiest" way – easy to transport when moving, almost invisible to store and ready for use in a flash. Space blends in with life, not the other way around – the perfect solution for a mobile generation.
